home.title: Indian restaurant and pub.
home.lead: Two rooms. Cooking from the tandoor. A proper bar.
home.buffet: Buffet lunch, Pointe-Claire only, Wednesday to Sunday 11:30–14:30.
home.buffetHours: Wednesday to Sunday, 11:30–14:30. This room only.
home.buffetBody: The freshly prepared lunch buffet is unmatched in the West Island: butter chicken, lamb curry, and chicken tikka. Five professional Indian chefs, every spice level.
home.buffetMore: Or sit down to a bhojan vegetarian platter, a tandoori grill feast, or a Birmingham balti pot. West Islanders voted our samosa the best.
home.house: Tandoor, balti pot, and a British-style Indian pub in both rooms — Taj Mahal and Cobra on tap. West Islanders voted our samosa the best.
home.trivia: Thursdays at 7:00 PM. Teams of up to 6. $50 prize. Reserve recommended.

about.title: About
about.lead: Two rooms on the West Island. Independent since 2003.
about.kitchen: Professional Indian chefs cook to every spice level. Lean, fat-free tandoori. Gluten-free choices. A vegetarian spread that is a menu, not an afterthought. Bhojan platters, tandoori grill feasts, and balti pots from the Birmingham tradition. West Islanders voted our samosa the best.
about.buffet: Pointe-Claire only, Wednesday to Sunday 11:30–14:30. Freshly prepared: butter chicken, lamb curry, chicken tikka. Five professional Indian chefs, every spice level.
about.pub: A British-style Indian pub in both rooms. Taj Mahal and Cobra on tap, with Guinness, Bass, and Newcastle. Domestic bottles and a long wine list. Weekday happy hour. Four large screens. Thursday trivia at Dorval.
about.visit: Dine-in, take-away, catering, and private events at both rooms. Delivery from Pointe-Claire only. Free parking. Gift certificates at the desk.

catering.title: Catering
catering.weddingsBody: Receptions and celebrations with custom menus — buffet or plated — for the day that matters.
catering.corporateBody: Working lunches, office parties, and client dinners. Flexible headcounts and delivery.
catering.privateBody: Birthdays, family gatherings, and private parties at either room or your venue.
